observation.visible_scene: Interior of a refrigerator. Three Nestlé Purified Water plastic bottles are present: two larger ones standing on a white shelf at the left, and a smaller one initially held aloft by a hand entering from the top right. A white appliance block sits at the right and a clear door bin is at the bottom right.
visible_changes: The hand grips the cap/top of the small bottle, holding it suspended with its base clearly above the shelf.
While held, the bottle's blue label blurs and its orientation changes in bursts (roughly frames 4-8 and 11-12), consistent with the bottle being rotated/spun about its vertical axis in the hand.
The suspended bottle is progressively lowered; its base, initially well above the shelf, descends until the bottle stands upright on the shelf (around frames 13-16).
Once the bottle rests, the fingers release and withdraw upward, leaving only fingertips at the top edge by about frame 25 and then largely out of frame.
The two larger left bottles remain stationary and unchanged throughout the excerpt.
A slight overall framing shift occurs between the first and last frames (the left bottles move a little toward the left edge), indicating minor camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the small bottle was lifted or obtained before the clip begins.
What the hand does after the clip ends (full withdrawal, closing the door, etc.).
Whether the label blurring was an intentional spin or incidental turning while positioning.
uncertain_details: Whether the periodic label blur reflects bottle rotation or camera jitter.
The exact direction and magnitude of the small camera framing shift.
